<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace AuthLib\Session;

use React\Promise\PromiseInterface;
use function React\Promise\resolve;
use function React\Promise\reject;

class HeaderEncoder
{
    private const ALLOWED_SCHEMES = ['Bearer', 'Basic', 'Digest'];
    
    /**
     * Encodes a value for safe inclusion in HTTP headers.
     * Strips null bytes and validates charset.
     */
    public function encode(string $value): string
    {
        // Remove null bytes
        $value = str_replace("\x00", '', $value);
        
        // Validate printable ASCII range
        if (!preg_match('/^[\x20-\x7E]*$/', $value)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Header value contains invalid characters');
        }
        
        return $value;
    }
    
    public function encodeScheme(string $scheme): string
    {
        if (!in_array($scheme, self::ALLOWED_SCHEMES, true)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid auth scheme');
        }
        return $scheme;
    }
}

class TokenNormalizer
{
    /**
     * Normalizes token by handling URL-encoded sequences that may appear
     * in tokens passed through query strings or form data.
     */
    public function normalize(string $token): string
    {
        // Decode percent-encoded characters for canonical form
        $decoded = $this->decodeTokenChars($token);
        
        // Strip leading/trailing whitespace from each line
        $lines = explode("\n", $decoded);
        $cleaned = array_map('trim', $lines);
        $result = implode('', $cleaned);
        
        return $result;
    }
    
    private function decodeTokenChars(string $input): string
    {
        // Only decode alphanumeric and safe token characters
        // This handles tokens that were URL-encoded in transit
        return rawurldecode($input);
    }
}

class AsyncAuthenticator
{
    private HeaderEncoder $headerEncoder;
    private TokenNormalizer $normalizer;
    private array $sessionStore = [];
    
    public function __construct(
        ?HeaderEncoder $headerEncoder = null,
        ?TokenNormalizer $normalizer = null
    ) {
        $this->headerEncoder = $headerEncoder ?? new HeaderEncoder();
        $this->normalizer = $normalizer ?? new TokenNormalizer();
    }
    
    /**
     * Authenticates a user and returns a promise resolving to the session header.
     * Uses async pattern for compatibility with ReactPHP event loop.
     */
    public function authenticateAsync(string $username, string $rawToken): PromiseInterface
    {
        return resolve(null)
            ->then(function () use ($username, $rawToken) {
                // Step 1: Normalize the token (handles URL-encoded input)
                $normalizedToken = $this->normalizer->normalize($rawToken);
                return ['username' => $username, 'token' => $normalizedToken];
            })
            ->then(function (array $credentials) {
                // Step 2: Validate credentials against store
                $token = $credentials['token'];
                $username = $credentials['username'];
                
                if (!$this->validateCredentials($username, $token)) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Authentication failed');
                }
                
                return $this->createSessionId($username);
            })
            ->then(function (string $sessionId) {
                // Step 3: Build the response header value
                return $this->buildAuthHeader($sessionId);
            });
    }
    
    private function validateCredentials(string $username, string $token): bool
    {
        // Simulated credential check - in production this hits a database
        $knownTokens = [
            'admin' => 'secret123',
            'user1' => 'token456',
        ];
        
        return isset($knownTokens[$username]) && hash_equals($knownTokens[$username], $token);
    }
    
    private function createSessionId(string $username): string
    {
        $sessionId = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $this->sessionStore[$sessionId] = [
            'username' => $username,
            'created' => time(),
        ];
        return $sessionId;
    }
    
    /**
     * Builds the Set-Cookie header value for the authenticated session.
     * The header encoder ensures no injection is possible.
     */
    private function buildAuthHeader(string $sessionId): string
    {
        $cookieValue = "session_id=" . $sessionId . "; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict";
        
        // Encode for header safety
        return $this->headerEncoder->encode($cookieValue);
    }
    
    /**
     * Alternative authentication flow that accepts a pre-formatted
     * authorization header value from a trusted upstream proxy.
     * The proxy may pass tokens with URL encoding.
     */
    public function authenticateFromProxyAsync(string $proxyHeader): PromiseInterface
    {
        return resolve($proxyHeader)
            ->then(function (string $header) {
                // Parse the proxy-forwarded auth header
                // Format: "<scheme> <encoded-credentials>"
                $parts = explode(' ', $header, 2);
                if (count($parts) !== 2) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Malformed proxy header');
                }
                
                $scheme = $this->headerEncoder->encodeScheme($parts[0]);
                $credentials = $parts[1];
                
                return ['scheme' => $scheme, 'credentials' => $credentials];
            })
            ->then(function (array $parsed) {
                // Normalize credentials (proxy may URL-encode them)
                $normalized = $this->normalizer->normalize($parsed['credentials']);
                
                // Reconstruct the validated header for downstream
                $headerValue = $parsed['scheme'] . ' ' . $normalized;
                
                // Final validation through header encoder
                return $this->headerEncoder->encode($headerValue);
            });
    }
}

// Usage example with ReactPHP
function handleAuthRequest(array $request): PromiseInterface
{
    $auth = new AsyncAuthenticator();
    
    if (isset($request['proxy_header'])) {
        return $auth->authenticateFromProxyAsync($request['proxy_header'])
            ->then(function (string $header) {
                return ['status' => 200, 'headers' => ['Authorization' => $header]];
            })
            ->otherwise(function (\Throwable $e) {
                return ['status' => 401, 'headers' => [], 'error' => $e->getMessage()];
            });
    }
    
    $username = $request['username'] ?? '';
    $token = $request['token'] ?? '';
    
    return $auth->authenticateAsync($username, $token)
        ->then(function (string $cookieHeader) {
            return ['status' => 200, 'headers' => ['Set-Cookie' => $cookieHeader]];
        })
        ->otherwise(function (\Throwable $e) {
            return ['status' => 401, 'headers' => [], 'error' => $e->getMessage()];
        });
}
